# NKE — Technicals

## TL;DR

As of May 4, 2026 (run `20260504_221111`), NKE remains in a confirmed downtrend. ADX 27.57 (above 25 threshold, trend real) with EMA cascade fully bearish on both daily and hourly. Price $43.09 (hourly) / $44.40 (daily close) is below every EMA from 5 through 200. RSI-7 at 21.68 is deeply oversold — creates violent bounce risk that vetoes shorting at current levels. Prior setup (May 1: "coin-flip mid-range") has been superseded: price drifted lower and short R/R is now worse. Wait for bounce to 10 EMA zone ($44.88–$44.96) for the clean short entry.

## Setup type

**No trade — wait for bounce to $44.88–$44.96.** EMA cascade confirms bearish continuation but RSI-7 at 21.68 creates oversold-bounce risk identical to the Apr 14 short that resulted in a -$35.70 loss (insider-buying bounce, see trades.md). R/R on a short at $43.09: target $42.09 = 1.0 pts gain, stop $46.10 = 3.01 pts risk = 0.33:1 — fails the 2:1 minimum by a wide margin. At the $44.88 bounce entry: target $42.09 = 2.79 pts gain, stop $46.10 = 1.22 pts risk = R/R ~2.3:1, clearing the threshold. Set alert at $44.88.
